versionDropdown.label: Abaqus version
versionDropdown.name: version
versionDropdown.help: Select the Abaqus version to use; the newest is selected by default. Abaqus is restricted software: you need to be on the access list (contact the HPRC helpdesk).

inputPicker.label: Abaqus input file
inputPicker.name: inputfile
inputPicker.help: Your Abaqus input file (.inp), on the cluster or uploaded from your computer. Its name becomes the job name (job.odb, job.dat, ...). Files it reads (*INCLUDE etc.) are found automatically when it is on the cluster.

usersub.label: User subroutine (optional)
usersub.name: usersub
usersub.help: Only if your model uses a user subroutine (UMAT, VUMAT, UEL, DLOAD, ...): the Fortran (.f) or C/C++ file, on the cluster or uploaded. Put all subroutines in one file. The compiler is loaded for you.

drona_fileUploader.label: Other model files (optional)
drona_fileUploader.help: Only needed when you upload the input file and it reads other files (*INCLUDE, amplitude or mesh files, abaqus_v6.env). Upload them here. Files of an input file on the cluster are found automatically.

cores.label: CPU cores (parallel run)
cores.name: cores
cores.help: How many CPU cores Abaqus runs on in parallel; 1 runs it in serial. Up to a full node, Abaqus uses threads on one node; more cores are spread over several nodes with MPI automatically. Small models often run best on 1 to 8 cores, and more cores use more license tokens (about 5 x cores^0.422: 1 core 5, 8 cores 12, 32 cores 21).

memory.label: Memory
memory.help: OPTIONAL: The total amount of memory you estimate the job needs. Abaqus is told to use 90% of it (memory=), so it stays inside the request. Too little memory makes Abaqus/Standard write to disk (slow) or stop; the .dat file of a datacheck run shows the memory the model needs. If you leave it empty, a default is used.

Walltime.label: Expected time needed to run
Walltime.help: OPTIONAL: The time you estimate the job will need. It's best to be conservative: if your job exceeds the requested time, it will be killed immediately and you might lose intermediate results. If you leave it empty, a default of 2 hours is used.

runtype.label: Run
runtype.name: runtype
runtype.help: ANALYSIS: the normal run. DATA CHECK: checks the model and reports the memory it needs, without solving; handy before a big job. SYNTAX CHECK: checks the input file only.

parallelDropdown.label: Parallel mode
parallelDropdown.name: parallel
parallelDropdown.help: AUTOMATIC (recommended): threads on one node, MPI when the cores need more than one node. THREADS: always one node (shared memory). MPI: separate processes, also on one node; some Abaqus/Explicit models run faster with MPI.

precision.label: Precision (Explicit only)
precision.name: precision
precision.help: Abaqus/Explicit runs in single precision by default. Choose double for long runs with many increments. Abaqus/Standard always uses double precision, so leave this for Standard models.

gpuDropdown.label: Use GPU
gpuDropdown.help: Rarely needed. NVIDIA GPUs speed up only the direct solver of Abaqus/Standard, for large implicit models (about a million degrees of freedom or more). Abaqus/Explicit doesn't use GPUs. Leave at no GPU unless you have measured a speed-up.

oldjob.label: Restart / import from job
oldjob.name: oldjob
oldjob.help: Only for input files with *RESTART, READ or *IMPORT: select a file of the earlier job (e.g. its .odb). Its other files are picked up automatically.

globalmodel.label: Global model (submodeling)
globalmodel.name: globalmodel
globalmodel.help: Only for input files with *SUBMODEL: select the global model's .odb.

abqoptions.label: Other abaqus options
abqoptions.name: abqoptions
abqoptions.help: OPTIONAL: Other options for the abaqus command, as option=value separated by spaces. job, input, cpus, mp_mode, gpus, memory, scratch, user, double, oldjob, globalmodel and datacheck are set from the form.
